open_points.subject: perform_service_operation
open_points.text: perform_service_operation: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that a call of an operation the imported SERVICE_RIGHTS constant does not give the calling service is refused with OUTSIDE_SERVICE_RIGHTS before any module is called and changes nothing: the CABINET member reading a customer's billing data, the PRESUPRO member publishing an artifact pointer and the CABINET_KERNEL member reading a project's context; that a token held by no service is refused with NO_VALID_TOKEN exactly as a wrong one; that a repeat of a create carrying an earlier request id is refused so too, never answered as a repeat; and that only a call of the CABINET_KERNEL member acts with an ActingPrincipal of the AGENT_VIA_KERNEL member of = models.PrincipalKind, a call of any other service never acting for an agent session.

open_points.question: Either SERVICE_RIGHTS must be added to IMPORTS and its imported data-access signature supplied, or the note must stop referring to it as an imported constant and state the evidence through the available service_may_call contract.

open_points.subject: OwnerActionStep.run
open_points.text: OwnerActionStep.run: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer through _refused, calling no module, a Refusal with the INVALID_REQUEST member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES constant names when a value the action's module needs is None, with one failure of the MISSING_VALUE member of = models.RefusalKind whose path is one PathElement naming target or the field of = models.OwnerValues that lacks it, and when end_date or erase_before is not text of four ASCII digits, a hyphen, two ASCII digits, a hyphen and two ASCII digits that names a real calendar date by its year, month and day, with one failure of the OUTSIDE_FORM member naming that field; given facts or a pointer not given MUST be handed on with every field None, so that their module refuses their missing values.
open_points.other_text: OwnerActionStep.run: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST leave every record's checks and writes to its module and the transaction's commit to the store: it MUST NOT write a record itself, open, commit or roll back a transaction, or check a stage other than the missing values its own calls need.
open_points.question: The dependency boundary must expressly permit the required end_date and erase_before form checks, or those form checks must be moved to the owning modules and removed from OwnerActionStep.run.

open_points.subject: _answer_class
open_points.text: _answer_class: [BEHAVIOR] MUST answer the PERSONAL_DATA member of = models.DisclosureClass when, in answer or in any model nested in it at any depth, a field that the imported PERSONAL_DATA_FIELDS constant lists for that model's name holds a value other than None and other than an empty tuple, and the BUSINESS_CONFIDENTIAL member otherwise, never the OPEN member; walking answer it MUST tell a model from any other value by isinstance against the pydantic base model class, take its fields by iterating the model, which yields each field's name and value in their declared order, and take a tuple's elements in their order, never with hasattr, getattr, setattr or vars and never through __dict__ or model_dump, and name a model by the name of its class.
open_points.rule: - Реализацию: не пиши алгоритм построчно, пиши требования к поведению
open_points.question: Keep the required classification behavior and permitted dependency boundary, but remove the prescribed step-by-step traversal implementation.

open_points.subject: _confirmation_inputs
open_points.text: _confirmation_inputs: [FALLBACK] MUST answer NoConfirmationInputs when a value the inputs of its action need is None or erase_before is not text of four ASCII digits, a hyphen, two ASCII digits, a hyphen and two ASCII digits that names a real calendar date by its year, month and day, so that a submission missing one is never bound to a step that showed it.
